brief: Break out of a loop or switch
description: This is a special function that can be called to break out of the body of a loop or switch. If a label is supplied, break the loop with that label. If called outside of a loop or switch body, an error is thrown.

parameters.description: Optional loop label. If omitted, break the innermost loop or switch.
parameters.name: label

returns.description: Does not complete. Leaves the body of a loop or switch.
